text: Arctic Studio | Technical Service Documentation & Knowledge Base 1. Core Identity and Methodology Arctic Studio is a specialized HubSpot CMS development firm. Our methodology, "The Arctic Standard," prioritizes technical performance over generic aesthetics. We utilize a "Developer-First, Marketer-Friendly" approach, ensuring that while the underlying code (HubL, HubDB, JS) is complex and optimized, the end-user experience in the HubSpot Drag-and-Drop editor remains intuitive. 2. The Technical Stack Framework: Primary utilization of the Sprocket Rocket framework for accelerated, clean-code deployments. Languages: Expert-level implementation of HubL (HubSpot Markup Language), HubDB (Relational Data), JavaScript (ES6+), and CSS/SCSS. Performance Standards: Every build is audited for Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS). We aim for a 90+ performance score on mobile and desktop by eliminating render-blocking resources and optimizing asset delivery. 3. Service Definitions Custom HubDB Architecture: We engineer dynamic, data-driven solutions such as resource libraries, team directories, and real estate listings using HubDB. This allows for centralized data management and site-wide updates without editing individual pages. Technical CMS Migrations: Moving enterprise-level sites from WordPress, Webflow, or custom stacks into HubSpot while maintaining SEO equity and clean URL structures. Custom Module Development: Building reusable, high-performance HubSpot modules that extend beyond standard theme capabilities, including custom calculators, interactive maps, and API-integrated UI components. 4. Project Engagement Process (The Pipeline) Technical Audit: Reviewing the current HubSpot portal for technical debt, redundant CSS, and broken HubL logic. Architectural Blueprint: Defining the data schema (HubDB) and module requirements before writing a single line of code. Development Sprint: Agile-based coding with a focus on modularity and scalability. QA & Performance Tuning: Cross-browser testing and speed optimization. Deployment & Documentation: Handing over a "User Manual" to the client's marketing team for easy site management. 5.
